system.description:
You gather a concentrated mass of star chakra above a point you can see within range, compressing it until it collapses under its own mass and weight, before dropping it like a falling meteor. Select a point you can see within range, filling a 20-foot radius centered on this point. All creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d8 force damage and being knocked Prone on a failed save.

Irradiated: The affected area is radioactive until the end of your next turn. Any creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d8 chakra damage on a failure and increasing the cost of their next jutsu cast within the next minute by the result of the chakra damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 (or 2-star chakra), and increase the damage by 1d8 and the size of the radius by +5 feet.
